channel.description: Latest articles from North Shore News (nsnews.com)

item.title: FIFA's Infantino has 'complete confidence' in Mexico to host World Cup games despite cartel violence
item.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — The violence that erupted in Mexico after the death of a powerful drug lord has left many questioning whether the country will be able to co-host the World Cup in just over three months.

item.title: One Tech Tip: Group chats are a way of life but come with unspoken etiquette
item.description: Communicating on group chats has quickly become a way of life, but what are the rules? We used to use email, the phone or talk in person.

item.title: AI song generator startups Suno and Udio angered the music industry. Now they're hoping to join it
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, Mass. (AP) — Suno CEO Mikey Shulman pulls up a chair to the recording studio desk where a research scientist at his artificial intelligence company is creating a new song. The flute line sounds promising. The percussion needs work.

item.title: Cuba says 4 killed in speedboat shooting were attempting to infiltrate the country
item.description: HAVANA (AP) — Cuba’s government said late Wednesday that the 10 passengers on a boat that opened fire on its soldiers were armed Cubans living in the U.S. who were trying to infiltrate the island and unleash terrorism.

item.title: Perfetti nets OT winner to lift Jets past Canucks 3-2
item.description: VANCOUVER — Cole Perfetti scored 1:37 into overtime to give the Winnipeg Jets a 3-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks in NHL play Wednesday night. Perfetti scored off a rebound of a Adam Lowry shot for his seventh goal of the year.

item.title: Vancouver Whitecaps down C.S. Cartagines, advance in CONCACAF Champions Cup
item.description: VANCOUVER — A successful season last year taught the Vancouver Whitecaps the importance of staying calm. Now the Major League Soccer club is leaning on that knowledge early in a new campaign.

item.title: Reports: Toronto Blue Jays, Max Scherzer reach agreement on one-year deal
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays and Max Scherzer have reached an agreement on a one-year deal worth US$3 million, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Joel Quenneville gets his 1,000th career win in Ducks' 6-5 comeback victory over Oilers
item.description: ANAHEIM, Calif. (AP) — Joel Quenneville became the second coach in NHL history to win 1,000 games with the Anaheim Ducks' 6-5 comeback victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday night.

item.title: Kucherov has a goal and 2 assists as the Lightning beat the Maple Leafs 4-2
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Nikita Kucherov scored to give him his ninth 30-goal season and added two assists for 701 in his career and the Tampa Bay Lightning defeated the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Wednesday night for their sixth straight victory.

item.title: Max Scherzer and Toronto Blue Jays agree to $3 million, 1-year deal, AP source says
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Max Scherzer is returning to the Toronto Blue Jays.
